## Summary

### <samp>🤖 Generated by Copilot at e3b1837</samp>

This pull request adds support for ES modules as output format for webpack. It updates the `APIPlugin` to handle different output formats, adds a new runtime global and a new initialization fragment for importing the `__WEBPACK_EXTERNAL_createRequire` function from the `module` built-in module in Node.js, and modifies the `ExternalModule` to handle the `node-commonjs` type. It also adds a new test case to verify the functionality and the API variable replacements.

### <samp>🤖 Generated by Copilot at e3b1837</samp>

*  Add support for ES modules as output format by modifying the expressions and runtime requirements for various webpack API variables ([link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-0b8525fd4794c93b31dd9e959e7e664fc6a79c68091046764063e3eace891764L27-R141), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-0b8525fd4794c93b31dd9e959e7e664fc6a79c68091046764063e3eace891764R147-R148), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-f01e290c9357ee8254e5ae51beb6a7225ced7fc41e32f3a0faf68bd8142738cbR66-R68), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-f01e290c9357ee8254e5ae51beb6a7225ced7fc41e32f3a0faf68bd8142738cbL110-R126), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-c3d58ece2e36cf9e319d260abb918fbfa8c8f0948c95d3f39b29907ea22ed30fR382-R386), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-01c0ec17c8c82af2e0c115384800d0d827f42365b28f0d37684cf7afc2b6d53aL371-R373), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-820a04017e95cec05fd58ca44cd7f6c9cfa5b698a144471d5a0f523932486c56R940-R951))
*  Add a test case for the feature by creating a `webpack.config.js` file that sets the output format to `module` and `iife`, defines some external modules, and adds a plugin that emits some assets ([link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-cf969008f89a6a5b67f0d790ab9783dee39b96481285188c730e742b52ea79a4R1-R58))
*  Add some test modules that use different import and export syntaxes, the `__non_webpack_require__` variable, and the `__WEBPACK_EXTERNAL_createRequire` function, and assert their values in `index.js` ([link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-65ad6c4a8052ea70922b17094eb0e50b640022dbc812d76fa037c051a759bbbbR1), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-169bb1109eb2ddd09eeec4820c326d066060f15f8e6210f2ab039b4aed70b493R1-R16), [link](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/17308/files?diff=unified&w=0#diff-623817666b785426dc5112436b4134722c51463a42b72d41e7b9d2781ecf603fR1))
